data.body: [P2] Apply the rejection exemption to the earlier retirement audit. When the first and only Invoke is definitively rejected, `context.attempts` remains nonempty, but legitimate retirement evidence has no native attempts, events, or histories. The earlier `validate_retirement_evidence(..., allow_no_launches=not context.attempts)` rejects that evidence and quarantines the target despite this exemption. Compute launch presence from attempts that are not proven rejections, while retaining retirement checks for created controls. Add a rejected-only case followed by another case on the same target.
